dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I've already organized all the materials related to the products and the business premises. Considering that the standard procedure of applying for the business license can take some time...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I recommend that you coordinate with your partner in Fontaine as soon as possible to decide on a timing for handling the paperwork.

dialogues.speaker: Yamada
dialogues.text: Oh dear! There I was, so caught up in choosing the new store location that I almost forgot about this. Almost messed up big time!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Please don't panic. According to the schedule we drew up, there's still ample buffer time.

dialogues.speaker: Yamada
dialogues.text: Miss Kuki Shinobu, you truly are a professional consultant. If it weren't for your help, I don't know how many pitfalls I might have fallen into on my first overseas business venture.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You're too kind. I'm simply doing my duty. I've accepted your commission — it is my responsibility to oversee every detail.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: As for the next phase of our marketing strategy, I have a fairly clear picture of our target audience, but I'll still need some time to scope out the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Yamada
dialogues.text: Of course! I really appreciate it. I'll check in with my partner first. We will reconvene once a suitable time has been arranged.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Alright, feel free to contact me anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}? What a coincidence running into you here. How have you been lately?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Yes. A business owner wants to promote Inazuman specialties in Fontaine, so she engaged me as a consultant. I'm also helping to draft the business plan.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Which brings me here on this business trip to assist with local procedures. It's a good chance to conduct market research too.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Speaking of which, this business owner is quite generous. After learning about the Gang's situation, she volunteered to cover travel expenses for the other members too.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So... Itto and the others are here as well!?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: That's right, we came here together.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Let me check the time... They should be underwater by now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Underwater?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Yes. "Underwater." Meaning, the Fortress of Meropide.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What happened!?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Whoa... WOOHOO! Man, the water feels great!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Pretty quick for such a teensy little ship, huh? But did you really think Arataki "The Man" Itto was gonna lose to some boat?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Akira, Mamoru, get in the water quick! Last one to catch that boat's a rotten egg! Not gonna be me thou— *cough* *glug* Hey! Do you even know how to swim, Genta!? 'Cuz splashing water in my mouth is not how you do it!

response.speaker: Genta
response.text: Boss... Wait... I still haven't learned... *glug* *glug*...

response.speaker: Elphane
response.text: Huh!? Pl—Please refrain from swimming in the aquarail waterway, passengers! It is very dangerous!

response.speaker: Elphane
response.text: I repeat: Foreign tourists must also comply with local laws! Passengers are not to swim in the aquarail waterway! This is a violation of the "Aquarail Traffic Safety Act"—

response.speaker: Elphane
response.text: Ugh, does anyone happen to know that very tall gentleman over there? Could you please help convince him to board the boat? Otherwise...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I apologize, Miss Melusine, for causing you trouble. I'll fish them out right away.

response.speaker: Elphane
response.text: Menthe. Good thing you're here...

response.speaker: Menthe
response.text: Understood. Hey, you, Big Guy! Your behavior constitutes a serious threat to public transportation safety. I'm going to need you to come with me!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? You got any proof? Who's been threatened? Everyone looks perfectly fine to me! Hmph. Y'know, I've got a top-notch lawyer on my side, don't say I didn't warn ya!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Besides, even that tengu warrior everyone's soooo scared of back home in Inazuma can't do nothin' to me. How's a shorty like you supposed to bring me in?

response.speaker: Menthe
response.text: Sh—Shorty…

response.speaker: Menthe
response.text: *sniff* That's really mean! Monsieur Neuvillette said I'm perfectly capable of doing any job I set my mind to! I'm going to arrest you right now!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Can it, Boss! Officer Melusine, I will cooperate and provide eyewitness testimony.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, Shinobu! Aren't we supposed to be on the same team!? How could you—

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: ...This isn't a big deal right now, but if you don't cooperate, this'll only escalate further. Wouldn't wanna make a fool of yourself while we're overseas, now, would you?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: First you switch sides, then you go and hit 'em a home run right out of the gate…

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: All done, Officer Melusine. You can take them now. They won't give you any trouble.

response.speaker: Akinori & Mamoru & Genta
response.text: Boss! Wherever you go, we'll follow!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: ...That about sums it up.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: It's not that serious. Their detention period will be just about over when I finish my business here. I'll just pick them up on the way back to Inazuma.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You have it tough...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Eh, this is nothing. I'm used to it.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I hear the Fortress of Meropide has a different management style from the Commissions' detention cells. It'll be a good opportunity for the Boss to broaden his horizons.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Are you free later? I'm planning to go pick out some gifts for Yanfei and Miss Kujou. I'd appreciate if you could provide a second opinion.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Thank you for your help. Just a moment, Ushi—

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Come on, we should get going.

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Ushi has always had his own principles. He never gets involved in anything the gang does that's unreasonable or against the law.

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo, moo!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: He also helps handle all sorts of errands within the gang. For example, Ushi was basically in charge of packing for this business trip.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I once advised him that he didn't need to force himself to stay by the Boss's side. With his talents, he could accomplish much greater things.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: But Ushi seems to have his own plans, and well, I trust his judgment.

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo...

choices.text: The Arataki Gang's business is booming!
Are you in Fontaine on business?
